title: GLUE-X: Evaluating Natural Language Understanding Models from an Out-of-Distribution Generalization Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness and generalization by training models on in-distribution source domains (e.g., standard GLUE tasks) and testing them on 15 out-of-distribution (OOD) target datasets from different domains to quantify performance decay.

Conducting post-hoc feature analysis using contextual decomposition to measure the rationale overlap between human and model predictions, identifying if models rely on superficial dataset artifacts rather than genuine language understanding.
